wording: Active self-monitoring improves recovery after unannounced internal impairment.

decision_rule.retain_if: For both held-out task families, post-impairment S2 accuracy exceeds S1 by >=0.15, the median S2 detection latency is <=3 episodes, mean self-estimated reliability falls by >=0.10 after impairment, and at least 18/20 seeds favour S2.
decision_rule.restrict_if: Recovery benefit or reliable detection is present in only one registered family.
decision_rule.reduce_if: Recovery is matched by S1 or occurs without a corresponding decrease in the nominated self-estimate.
decision_rule.reject_if: Active self-monitoring does not improve post-impairment recovery.
